messages:
maria_support: Customer (acme-corp) escalated: legend entries don't match series after analytics deploy. Screenshot: https://redwood.s3/esc/2026/03/acme-legend-mismatch.png

alex_mobile_qe: I can reproduce on Pixel 6 / Chrome mobile in compact dashboard. Legend order shifts after pinch-zoom and tooltips show values from a different series (color/label mismatch).

jamie_frontend: Thanks — can you paste clear repro steps + any console/network logs? Is this blocking the customer?

maria_support: It's P1 for them (blocking dashboards). Repro steps from the user:
1) Open Dashboard -> compact layout
2) Select 7d range
3) Pinch-zoom to narrow timeframe (~3d)
4) Tap a point or bar -> tooltip appears but the value/label corresponds to another series; legend highlights a different entry. Started after deploy on 2026-03-12.

alex_mobile_qe: Console snippets from repro session:
```
14:32:20 console.warn: legend: mapping mismatch: seriesIndex 1 -> seriesKey 'latency' but tooltipSeriesId 2
14:32:21 fetch /api/metrics?range=3d 200 240ms
14:32:21 dom: legend-item[2] assigned color #f36c21 but series[2].color = #4a9df3
```

jamie_frontend: This smells like DOM recycling / virtualization causing index-based mapping to be stale in compact mode. We changed legend wrapping CSS earlier which might reorder DOM nodes while chart state still maps by index. What chart lib version are we on?

noah_engineer: We're on our fork of charty v2.1.0+patch in prod. I inspected the deploy diff — there was a CSS change to legend flow to improve wrapping on narrow containers. Assigning to eng-frontend to triage. @jamie_frontend can you take ownership? I'll prepare a rollback canary if needed.

jamie_frontend: Taking it. Quick investigation: mapping should use series.id instead of DOM index; will prototype a minimal fix that resolves tooltip->legend mapping regardless of DOM order. Pushed branch: refs/compact-legend-id-fix.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary compact-dashboard 2026-03-14T18:10Z -> success

sarah_product: Customer agreed to canary test. Maria, once canary's live can you validate with acme-corp and ask them to clear browser cache/local storage to ensure new assets?

maria_support: Will coordinate. FYI the user also mentioned a missing data point in the last 24h for endpoint 'ingest.latency' — adding that as a separate analytics investigation but keeping it in this thread for context.

noah_engineer: Filed ENG-6723: "compact dashboard legend id mismatch + tooltip mapping" and linked the canary results.

alex_mobile_qe: Quick verification after canary: Pixel/Chromium looks fixed. Still seeing an edge case on iPad Safari when compact + density=high (retina) — tooltip aligns but legend highlight lags by one item. I attached video: https://redwood.s3/esc/2026/03/ipad-legend-lag.mov

jamie_frontend: Thanks — I'll add retina/density guard and ensure we read series.datasetId where available. ETA: EOD.

maria_support: Thanks everyone :heart: I'll update the customer and close the loop here once acme confirms. If they still see issues I'll reopen.
